ENGLISH MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. happiness

4. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes ● formation of nouns (nouns formed from other , which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes ● formation of nouns (nouns formed from other .

   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes ● formation of nouns (nouns formed from other .

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .

7. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs.

8. When practising Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe.

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action
